description: This line plot illustrates how BLEU scores vary with different levels of average lagging (AL) for four distinct training consistency methods. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL)”, spans from 0.0 to 10.0 in linear scale with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU”, ranges from 18 to 28, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot displays four lines: “Consistency-CE” is a light purple dashed line with circle markers, starting at approximately 19.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and rising to about 26.0 at AL=10.0; “Inconsistency-CE” is a dark purple solid line with square markers, beginning at approximately 20.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and increasing to about 27.0 at AL=10.0; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” is a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at 18.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and rising to about 27.0 at AL=10.0; and “Consistency-Bi” is a red solid line with star markers, beginning at approximately 22.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and peaking at about 29.0 BLEU at AL=7.5 before slightly declining to about 28.5 at AL=10.0.
